title: Kloaken's Portalis
description: A mod that strives to make it easy to get from place to place without being too overpowered.
body:
![2 item frames holding the portal crystal and the other holding the portal transceiver. In the middle is there the block of portal connector](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a000d01f63be676f46a88aab0764f6e48d102d8e.png)Tired of the endless hold-W simulator?

Portalis is a utility mod that redefines how you navigate your world. Portalis offers a network of "waystones" or portals to connect your scattered bases, or getting back to a nether fortress, this mod bridges the gap between where you are and where you need to be. No fluff, no clunky UIs just pure, instantaneous travel. 

This mod adds 3 things:

Portal Crystal: It allows you to set your teleportation coordinates. Works trough dimensions and has no range limit.

Portal Transceiver: It allows you to teleport to the Cyrstals set coordinates.

Portal Connector: Allows you to set the coordinates of the portal Transceiver with the portal Crystal.
